topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Group code of conduct and security acknowledgments; sanctions procedure (POL-01 4.12)
Board risk committee oversees cyber risk quarterly; board audit committee oversees internal audit
Group CISO, Integrity Services Client Security Officer, and CTO with defined reporting lines (POL-01 section 3)
Background checks; annual awareness and role-based training; engineer qualifications
Control owners named in the common control catalog and the IDP control matrix; performance objectives include security
IDP asset and data inventory; SIEM and monitoring data used to operate controls

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies, supplements, and the Integrity Services security handbook communicated to staff; annual acknowledgment
Client security exhibit, SOC 2 system description, and client portal notices communicate commitments
gap: No register of negotiated client notice terms; marketing material claims SSI handling under 49 CFR Part 1520 that is not yet in place
remediation: Client notice register (POAM-005); correct the SSI claim by 2026-10-15 (POAM-023 milestone) and describe the SSI program once live (POAM-019)

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Service commitments and system requirements defined in the system description and client exhibit
Annual division risk analysis rolled up to the group register (P01 ES-001 to ES-018)
Fraud risk considered in the group ERM process and internal audit plan
Change triggers in POL-01 (acquisitions, new services, AI use) prompt risk review
Group internal audit assesses common controls yearly and sampled Integrity Services controls (P07); SOC monitors continuously
Findings tracked in the POA&M with owners and dates; reported to the board risk committee

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from the risk analysis and the common control catalog
General IT controls inherited from group common controls (identity, SOC, cloud)

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Group policies and the Integrity Services supplement deploy controls through procedures

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Tenant isolation by row-level security; encryption at rest and in transit; group key management
gap: SSI datasets inside client tenants are not separated, labeled, or restricted to need-to-know groups
remediation: Label SSI datasets; need-to-know groups; separate SSI store (POAM-019)

control_description: Workforce access requested and approved in identity governance; client users provisioned by client administrators
Role-based access; quarterly certification
gap: Any engineer on a client account can read all of that client's data, including SSI (P07 AC-03 result)

control_description: Physical security of data centers carved out to cloud providers A and B (subservice organizations)
Tenant offboarding deletes client data with a certificate; media sanitization by providers

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Perimeter protections, web application firewall, MFA for workforce and client administrators
evidence: Firewall and WAF configuration; MFA policy
gap: MFA is optional for about 3,600 of 3,900 client users (P01 ES-016)
remediation: Require MFA for all client users by 2027-03-31 (POL-02 4.12)

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: Encrypted transfer for ILI data intake and client exports; data loss prevention on exports

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on workloads; malware scanning of ILI vendor uploads; signed container images

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Vulnerability scanning; configuration compliance against cloud guardrails

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: 24x7 SOC monitoring of IDP logs and cloud audit events
Security events triaged and evaluated under group playbooks
Group incident response plan and P08 runbook apply; client notice duty in the client exhibit
gap: No client notice register and no SSI disclosure step in procedures; cross-division exercise not yet held
remediation: Client notice register and SSI step (POAM-005); tabletop (POAM-004)

control_description: Restore from immutable backups; post-incident reviews
Changes through the platform release process with peer review, testing, and approval; infrastructure as code
Business continuity for the IDP: warm standby in provider B; cyber insurance

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Subservice providers (cloud providers A and B, identity SaaS, ticketing SaaS) reviewed yearly from their SOC 2 reports
gap: No monitoring of subservice providers between annual reviews; complementary subservice organization controls not mapped quarterly

control_description: Capacity monitoring and autoscaling for the IDP
Immutable daily backups; warm standby in provider B; environmental protections carved out to providers
Annual failover test to the provider B standby
gap: The 2026-02 failover took 5.5 hours against a 4-hour recovery time objective (P05 BP-E01); tests only yearly
remediation: Fix the database promotion step; test twice a year (P01 ES-011)

topic_label: Identification and maintenance of confidential information
control_description: Client data classified Confidential; CEII and SSI to be classified Restricted (POL-04)
gap: SSI and CEII inside client tenants are not identified, marked, or handled as Restricted; no SSI register
remediation: SSI program and register; labeling in the IDP (POAM-019)
